technical-leadership.name: Technical leadership
technical-leadership.description: Lead technical reviews, mentor engineers, and coordinate delivery decisions.

technical-strategy.name: Cross-team technical strategy
technical-strategy.description: Set technical direction and coordinate architecture changes across teams.

incident-management.name: Incident triage and recovery
incident-management.description: Use telemetry and runbooks to isolate production failures, restore service, and verify corrective actions after recovery.

privacy-engineering.name: PII redaction and data minimization
privacy-engineering.description: Identify sensitive fields, limit their collection and exposure, and define redaction rules for logs, exports, and analytics.

auditability.name: Audit event logging
auditability.description: Record actor, action, resource, timestamp, and outcome for sensitive operations with controlled access and retention.

authentication.name: Session and token authentication
authentication.description: Implement session creation, expiration, revocation, and token verification, and test rejected, expired, and replayed credentials.

authorization.name: Role-based and resource-level authorization
authorization.description: Enforce role permissions and resource ownership on the server, with tests for cross-user and cross-tenant access attempts.

secrets-management.name: Secrets management
secrets-management.description: Store, rotate, and restrict access to credentials without exposing them in code or logs.

continuous-integration.name: Continuous integration
continuous-integration.description: Automate builds, static checks, and tests for changes before delivery.

contract-testing.name: Contract testing
contract-testing.description: Verify that API producers and consumers agree on request, response, and compatibility rules.

load-testing.name: Load and performance testing
load-testing.description: Measure throughput, latency, and failure behavior under realistic traffic.

dependency-security.name: Dependency security
dependency-security.description: Identify vulnerable dependencies and apply verified updates without breaking application behavior.

threat-modeling.name: Threat modeling
threat-modeling.description: Identify attack paths and select controls based on system boundaries and sensitive assets.

disaster-recovery.name: Disaster recovery
disaster-recovery.description: Design and test backup, restoration, and failover procedures against recovery objectives.

architecture-decisions.name: Architecture decision records (ADRs)
architecture-decisions.description: Record a concrete design choice, alternatives, constraints, and operational tradeoffs so later changes can be evaluated against the original decision.

capacity-planning.name: Workload capacity modeling
capacity-planning.description: Translate traffic and data-growth assumptions into concurrency, resource, and saturation estimates, then validate them with workload measurements.

cost-optimization.name: Infrastructure cost optimization
cost-optimization.description: Identify resource waste and balance infrastructure spending against performance and reliability needs.

engineering-standards.name: Engineering standards and governance
engineering-standards.description: Establish shared technical practices and guide their adoption across teams.

unit-testing.name: Unit testing
unit-testing.description: Write isolated tests for business rules, boundary values, and failure paths using deterministic fixtures and assertions.

integration-testing.name: Integration testing
integration-testing.description: Verify interactions with databases, APIs, and queues using controlled test data, cleanup, and dependency failure scenarios.

schema-validation.name: Schema validation
schema-validation.description: Validate incoming records and requests against schemas, type constraints, size limits, and allowed values before processing.

deployment-rollbacks.name: Deployment health checks and rollbacks
deployment-rollbacks.description: Gate application rollouts on readiness and health checks, detect failed releases, and restore a compatible application version.

structured-logging.name: Structured logging
structured-logging.description: Emit machine-readable events with request identifiers and error context while redacting credentials and personal data.

application-metrics.name: Application metrics instrumentation
application-metrics.description: Instrument request rates, error counts, and latency histograms with bounded label cardinality and actionable dashboards.

distributed-tracing.name: Distributed tracing
distributed-tracing.description: Instrument spans and propagate trace context across service calls and asynchronous messages to locate failing or slow dependencies.
